It tastes great, but hearty truffles are for more effective when cooked in a recipe.|Inventory|TotK}} ==Location and Uses== ==={{BotW|-}}=== Toasted Hearty Truffles are a variety of [[Roasted Food]], and they can be made by exposing [[Hearty Truffle]]s to [[Fire]] or a [[Scorching Climate]].{{Cite Guide|BotW Piggyback|page= 295}} Their outsides are known to be crispy, while their insides are warm and gooey. Eating one restores three [[Heart]]s to [[Link]]'s [[Life Gauge]]. ==={{TotK|-}}=== Toasted Hearty Truffles reappear in {{TotK}} and are again a variety of [[Roasted Food]]. [[Link]] can make them by dropping [[Hearty Truffle]]s near [[Fire]] or in a [[Scorching Climate]]. Although they are known to be crispy and delicious, many consider [[Cooking]] Hearty Truffles into [[Food]] to be more effective. If Link eats a Toasted Hearty Truffle, he will regain three of his [[Life Gauge]]'s [[Heart]]s. ==Nomenclature== {{Nomenclature}} ==See Also== {{See Also| * Food * Hearty Truffle * Roasted Food * Toasted Big Hearty Truffle }} {{Ref}} {{Categories |Food, Health Restoring Items, Roasted Food |items= BotW, TotK }}
